activation_method: KOH chemical activation: KOH pellets physically mixed with BC powder (100-200 um) at KOH/BC weight ratio W = 4; nickel crucible in a muffle furnace, 3 C/min to 800 C, held 2 h, under N2 (300 mL/min)
notes: archive: fig9b_AC4_magenta_part2.json | digitized pressure 6.8401 MPa | marker partly hidden by overlapping markers of other series (15 px visible); centroid of the visible part | Fig. 9b (p. 1257): 77 K, high pressure, HPVA-100 (VTI Corporation of TA Instruments), which the paper calls a "gravimetric analyzer" (the model name suggests a volumetric instrument); method coded as printed; no buoyancy correction stated, so basis_inferred unknown. Pressure axis "Pressure (Mpa)", not stated absolute or gauge, taken as absolute; MPa x 10 = bar. Each sample shows two nearly coincident plotted lines; the text says "There was no hysteresis cycle" but does not mark which points are desorption, so every point is coded adsorption. isotherm_point_count 16: one marker near 0.13 MPa, overlapping marker pairs near 0.27, 0.40, 0.67 and 1.37 MPa (not separable, not extracted) and seven single markers from 2.6 to 7.95 MPa (count taken from AC2 and AC3, where all are visible). | Table 2 (p. 1254): W 4, S_BET 3148 m2/g, V0.99 1.60 cm3/g (total pore volume, N2 at P/P0 = 0.99), V_DR 0.98 cm3/g (Dubinin-Radushkevich micropore volume, N2 77 K), Ea 19.03 kJ/mol (DR characteristic energy), L0 1.42 nm (Stoeckli average micropore width), V_DR/V0.99 0.61, V_meso 0.62 cm3/g.
